verdict.rationale: Bento exposes broad API surface (events, subscribers, transactional email, webhooks) plus first-party SDKs, a 50+ command CLI, and an MCP server for natural-language account management, suggesting most UI actions have programmatic equivalents. However, there is no explicit documentation claiming full UI/API parity, and probes show no discoverable OpenAPI spec, leaving some ambiguity about complete coverage (e.g., billing, account transfer, or segment builder UI features via API). Missing for 10: an explicit parity statement or complete OpenAPI/schema confirming all UI actions are API-accessible, and independent verification of coverage gaps.
